# dsh-file-manager
Adds the write direction to DeepSeek Harness Web's **Files** feature: **upload, download, zip a fold
er, rename, delete and create folders** — no SFTP client needed for day-to-day work in a session wor
ame, delete and create folders** — no SFTP client needed for day-to-day work in a session workspace.
The shipped files panel only lists and previews. This plugin adds an authenticated, workspace-confin
ed transfer channel plus a full manager tab.
## What it adds
| Where | What |
| New **文件管理** tab in the right sidebar (reachable from the guide page) | breadcrumb navigation, dir
ectories-first ordering, multi-select, drag & drop upload (folders included), per-file progress and

cancel, overwrite confirmation, file download, folder ZIP download, rename, delete, new folder |
| A
ction row of the shipped **文件** tab | **Upload**, **ZIP download** and **Open manager** for the fold

er currently displayed |
| Action row of the document preview tab | **Download** for the open file |
Uploads stream to disk (no full-file buffering), downloads honour HTTP `Range`, folder archives are
streamed as the tree is walked.

## Host routes
All under `/api2/dsh-file-manager/*` (not the reflection-owned `/api` channel):
| Method | Path | Purpose |

| GET | `/info?sessionId` | session workspace root |
| GET | `/list?sessionId&path` | one directory

level |
| POST | `/upload?sessionId&path&name&overwrite` | raw `application/octet-stream` body strea

med to disk; `name` may contain `a/b/c` |
| GET | `/download?sessionId&path[&inline=1]` | one file,

`Range` supported |
| GET | `/zip?sessionId&path` | streamed ZIP of a directory |
| POST | `/mkdir`

| JSON `{sessionId, path}` |
| POST | `/move` | JSON `{sessionId, from, to, overwrite?}` |
| POST |

`/copy` | JSON `{sessionId, from, to, overwrite?}` |
| POST | `/delete` | JSON `{sessionId, paths: [

y` | JSON `{sessionId, from, to, overwrite?}` |
| POST | `/delete` | JSON `{sessionId, paths: []}` |
Success is `{ "ok": true, "value": … }`; failures are `{ "ok": false, "error": { code, message, deta
ils } }` with a matching status (`outside-workspace` 403, `exists` 409, `upload-too-large` 413, …).
## Security
- **Auth & origin**: every route first asks the composition's `connection.requestRejection()` — the
same Host/Origin fence plus browser session cookie that guards the official `/api` channel. A compos

ition without Connection is refused, not served.
- **CSRF**: every mutating route also requires the

custom header `x-dsh-fm: 1`, which a cross-site form cannot set.
- **Workspace confinement**: paths
resolve against the session `cwd` (falling back to `sandboxPolicy.workspaceRoot`), absolute paths in
cluded; `..` cannot climb out, and the real path is re-checked, so **a symlink pointing outside the

workspace is refused** for download, zip, delete and move alike.
- **Overwrite**: upload and move re

fuse to clobber by default (`exists`); the browser confirms and retries with `overwrite`.
- **Ceilin
gs**: 16 GiB per upload (`maxUploadBytes`), 5000 listed entries, ZIP up to 60000 entries / 4 GiB (ZI
16 GiB per upload (`maxUploadBytes`), 5000 listed entries, ZIP up to 60000 entries / 4 GiB (ZIP32).

## Known limits
- **No resumable upload**: a failed upload restarts from byte zero; downloads can resume through `Ra

nge`.
- **Copy fallback before the host reloads**: the `/copy` route needs a dsh restart. Until it i
s live, paste falls back to download + re-upload (recursing through directories) — same result, slow

er; the server route is used automatically once loaded.
- **ZIP32 only**: archives beyond 4 GiB or 6

0000 entries fail with a clear error rather than producing a corrupt file.
- **No permission/ownersh

ip editing**: `chmod`/`chown` are out of scope.
- **One workspace**: it manages the current session'

s workspace only.
- **Takeover, not a sibling**: the panel is the same `files` type, so the shipped
implementation is shadowed until the plugin unloads; two file panels never appear side by side.
